definitions.explanation: Suffix indicating a curated selection or anthology of works.

examples.japanese: {傑作|けっさく}{選|せん}を{出版|しゅっぱん}した。
examples.english: They published a selection of masterpieces.

examples.japanese: {名|めい}{曲|きょく}{選|せん}を{聴|き}いた。
examples.english: I listened to a collection of famous pieces.

examples.japanese: {短編|たんぺん}{小説|しょうせつ}{選|せん}が{本屋|ほんや}で{売|う}っている。
examples.english: A short story anthology is being sold at the bookstore.

notes:
{選|せん} is a suffix indicating a curated selection or anthology.

COMPOUNDS:

Books/Literature:
- {傑作|けっさく}{選|せん}: selection of masterpieces
- {短編|たんぺん}{選|せん}: short story anthology
- {詩|し}{選|せん}: poetry anthology
- {名作|めいさく}{選|せん}: collection of famous works

Music:
- {名|めい}{曲|きょく}{選|せん}: selection of famous songs
- ベスト{選|せん}: best selection

Photography/Art:
- {写真|しゃしん}{選|せん}: photo selection
- {作品|さくひん}{選|せん}: selected works

RELATED WORDS:
- {選|えら}ぶ: to choose, select (verb)
- {選集|せんしゅう}: anthology, collected works
- {選択|せんたく}: selection, choice
